Maya L.: Quick notewe need a smoother path for adding rollout metadata that affects placement. Strict flips are breaking older deploys.
Jon H.: Agreed. Proposal: introduce an adapter layer in control-plane that can map a bounded set of v2 keys into v1-safe fields at read time. No mandatory backfill.
Priya N.: Add three validation modes: permissive (ignore), warn (metric + warning), strict (reject). Start permissive, then warn, then teams can opt into strict.
Sam C.: Runtimes advertise capabilities via manifest and an X-Runtime-Capabilities header (e.g., schema:v2;placement_v2). Control-plane only applies v2 routing when node declares placement_v2.
Maya L.: Also add shadow-eval: evaluate v2 routing in shadow and emit diffs; collect `shadow_mismatch_pct`.
deploy-bot: Canary started for adapter service (adp-2026-09) 4/8 pods healthy.
Jon H.: Telemetry: schema_adapter_mapped, schema_warn_count, schema_strict_rejects, shadow_mismatch_pct.
Priya N.: Export format: always include top-level v1 fields plus optional `serialized_v2` blob. Importers that understand it can prefer v2.
Sam C.: Safety rule: unknown v2 keys must not change placement or cost unless explicit capability present. Adapter can map only with permission.
Maya L.: I'll write a short RFC with mapping examples, handshake details, validation modes, and the canary plan. Please review when I post.
